close_reason: Advisory-only contract documented in crate-level doc and LintRunner; Fatal clarified as lint-evaluation stop only
description:
pkix-lint must be explicitly documented and enforced as report-only. LintResult::Fatal means 'stop evaluating further lints for this item' — it does NOT propagate to the TLS stack as a cert rejection. Hard-fail behavior at the TLS layer is the responsibility of the integration layer (pkix-chain or wolfSSL binding), not pkix-lint.

Changes needed:
1. Add explicit rustdoc to LintResult::Fatal clarifying it stops lint evaluation, not cert acceptance
2. Add explicit rustdoc to LintRunner stating findings are advisory only
3. Ensure there is no code path in pkix-lint that returns an Err() causing a cert rejection
4. Document in crate-level docs: 'pkix-lint findings are advisory. Whether to reject a cert based on findings is the caller's decision, configured per finding-ID at the integration layer.'

The integration layer design (which finding-IDs map to hard-fail in pkix-chain) is a separate issue.
title: pkix-lint: LintResult::Fatal is report-only, never TLS-stack hard-fail
